tasks.subject: Task 1: demo-lib package + dev environment
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The gh-pages-pypi-demo-lib package exists, is installable, tested, and buildable; repo has a working dev venv.

**Files:** Create packages/demo-lib/{pyproject.toml,README.md,src/gh_pages_pypi_demo_lib/__init__.py}; Test tests/test_packages.py

**Verify:** .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_packages.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/demo-lib/pyproject.toml", "packages/demo-lib/README.md", "packages/demo-lib/src/gh_pages_pypi_demo_lib/__init__.py", "tests/test_packages.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_packages.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["venv exists with pytest, build, pyyaml", "greeting returns expected string", "build produces wheel and sdist"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: demo-app package (depends on demo-lib)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** gh-pages-pypi-demo-app exists with a demo-app console script that uses gh-pages-pypi-demo-lib.

**Files:** Create packages/demo-app/{pyproject.toml,README.md,src/gh_pages_pypi_demo_app/__init__.py}; Modify tests/test_packages.py

**Verify:** .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_packages.py -v (3 passed); .venv/bin/demo-app

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/demo-app/pyproject.toml", "packages/demo-app/README.md", "packages/demo-app/src/gh_pages_pypi_demo_app/__init__.py", "tests/test_packages.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_packages.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["main prints greeting from lib", "console script installed", "build produces wheel and sdist"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: build_index.py PEP 503 index generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stdlib-only script turning GitHub release assets into a static PEP 503 index, unit-tested against fixture JSON.

**Files:** Create scripts/build_index.py; Test tests/test_build_index.py

**Verify:** .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_build_index.py -v (5 passed)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/build_index.py", "tests/test_build_index.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_build_index.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["normalize per PEP 503", "filename parsing with non-package assets ignored", "generated HTML with sha256 fragments", "fails loudly on empty index"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: release.yml tag-triggered releases
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pushing a tag like demo-lib-v1.0.0 builds that package and publishes a GitHub Release with wheel+sdist, then dispatches pages.yml.

**Files:** Create .github/workflows/release.yml

**Verify:** YAML parses via pyyaml

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/release.yml"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -c \"import yaml, pathlib; yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/release.yml').read_text()); print('OK')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tag trigger", "version mismatch fails", "release created with artifacts", "pages workflow dispatched"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: pages.yml index build + Pages deploy
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Workflow regenerating the PEP 503 index from release assets and deploying to GitHub Pages.

**Files:** Create .github/workflows/pages.yml

**Verify:** YAML parses via pyyaml

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/pages.yml"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -c \"import yaml, pathlib; yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/pages.yml').read_text()); print('OK')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["correct triggers", "index built with token", "official pages deploy actions"]}
```
